name: com.vykadiamonds/vyka-diamonds
title: VYKA Diamonds
description: Search VYKA's certified natural and lab-grown diamonds and get GIA or IGI report-check links.

tools.name: search_diamonds
tools.description: Returns loose diamonds currently listed on vykadiamonds.com (VYKA, Dubai), natural or lab-grown, with the same selection, order and prices as the website's diamond pages. Use this when the user wants to find or compare diamonds VYKA sells, by shape, carat, colour, clarity or budget. Only stones with a laboratory grading report are returned (natural: GIA, IGI or HRD; lab-grown: also GCAL). Unless the user sets a value, the website's own starting filters apply: natural 0.5 ct and up, colour D–H, clarity VS2 or better, Excellent or Ideal cut where the laboratory grades cut, Very Good or Excellent polish and symmetry; lab-grown 1.0 ct and up, colour D–F, clarity VS1 or better, Excellent or Ideal cut where graded, Excellent polish and symmetry; both: eye-clean, no tinge, returnable, with photo and 360° view, lowest price first. Any value the user gives replaces that default. Limits: at most 10 stones per call; stock changes quickly and a listed stone can sell at any time; AED prices are the charged prices, other currencies are indicative. Does not cover ring settings, finished rings, gemstones or fancy-colour diamonds, and cannot reserve or buy a stone.

type.description: natural = mined diamonds; lab = lab-grown diamonds.

shape.description: One or more shapes. Leave out for every shape.

carat_max.description: Largest carat weight (20 = no upper limit).

colour_highest.description: Highest colour grade to include (D is the highest).

colour_lowest.description: Lowest colour grade to include, e.g. G for 'G or better'.

clarity_highest.description: Highest clarity grade to include (FL is the highest).

clarity_lowest.description: Lowest clarity grade to include, e.g. VS1 for 'VS1 or better'.

currency.description: Currency of max_price and of the indicative price shown beside the AED price.

tools.name: get_diamond
tools.description: Returns one diamond from VYKA's diamond inventory by its certificate (report) number or VYKA stone code (VYK-…), with the details its page on vykadiamonds.com shows: grades, measurements, AED price (plus an indicative currency), photo, its page link and the laboratory's report-check link. Use this when the user gives a report number or VYK code, or to re-check a stone from search_diamonds before they decide or contact VYKA. Limits: only stones VYKA currently lists can be found. found is false when VYKA does not list that number now (it may have sold, or VYKA may never have listed it); that says nothing about whether the report is genuine, and report_check_links then gives the laboratory's own check. It does not verify the report itself.

code.description: A GIA or IGI report number (e.g. 2141438171) or a VYKA stone code (e.g. VYK-I-612345678).

currency.description: Currency for the indicative price beside the AED price.

tools.name: check_report
tools.description: Returns the web address of the grading laboratory's own report-check page for a GIA or IGI report number, after checking that the number has that laboratory's format. Use this when the user wants to verify a diamond's grading report themselves. Limits: it only builds the link; it does not open, read or confirm the report, and only GIA and IGI are supported. For an IGI number starting with LG it also notes that such reports are normally for lab-grown diamonds.

lab.description: The laboratory that issued the report.

report_number.description: The report number printed on the report (GIA: 7–10 digits; IGI: 7–10 digits, lab-grown reports may start with LG).

tools.name: talk_to_jeweller
tools.description: Returns a WhatsApp link to VYKA's sales line (+971 52 273 1161) with a pre-written first message, about a stone (report number or VYK code) or a vykadiamonds.com product page, in English or Arabic. Use this only when the user asks to contact VYKA, speak to a jeweller or enquire on WhatsApp. Limits: nothing is sent; the user opens the link, can edit the message and sends it themselves. No personal details are asked for or kept.

stone.description: Optional: the stone's report number or VYK code.

product_url.description: Optional: a product page on vykadiamonds.com.

language.description: Language of the message and the website link.

tools.name: vyka_score
tools.description: Returns VYKA's 0–100 quality score for a diamond and how it was calculated. Use this when the user asks for the VYKA Score of a stone in VYKA's inventory (give its report number or VYK code) or wants a diamond they describe scored on VYKA's scale (give type, shape, carat, colour and clarity, and any of cut, polish, symmetry, fluorescence, lab, eye-clean and proportions). Limits: it is VYKA's own guide computed from the report figures, not a laboratory grade; natural and lab-grown diamonds are scored on separate scales that do not compare; only white diamonds in the ten main shapes are scored; figures left out make the score less certain (figures_used shows how many were used).

code.description: A report number or VYK code of a stone VYKA lists. Use either this or the specs below.

eye_clean.description: True when the listing says the stone is eye-clean, false when it says it is not. Leave out when unknown.
